question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Final query: Count actors with more films with Yash Chopra than any other director
WITH yash_movies AS (
    SELECT MID FROM M_Director WHERE PID = 'nm0007181'
),
-- All actor-director pair counts
actor_dir_counts AS (
    SELECT TRIM(mc.PID) as actor_pid, md.PID as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.MID) as film_count
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN M_Director md ON mc.MID = md.MID
    WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRIM(mc.PID), md.PID
),
-- Actors who worked with Yash Chopra
actors_with_yash AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT actor_pid FROM actor_dir_counts WHERE director_pid = 'nm0007181'
),
-- Yash Chopra count for each actor
yash_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, film_count as yash_film_count
    FROM actor_dir_counts
    WHERE director_pid = 'nm0007181'
),
-- Max count with any OTHER director
other_max AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, MAX(film_count) as max_other_count
    FROM actor_dir_counts
    WHERE director_pid != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY actor_pid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actors_with_yash ay
JOIN yash_counts yc ON ay.actor_pid = yc.actor_pid
JOIN other_max om ON ay.actor_pid = om.actor_pid
WHERE yc.yash_film_count > om.max_other_count
